purpose: Read-only EC07 discovery inventory; not a runtime schema, new interface contract, ADR selection or completion packet
scope: Named Auditctl source files plus three committed consumer edges; not exhaustive estate consumer inventory
prerequisites: EC03 canonical generation before new interfaces

boundaries.producer: Source-domain publisher after its own authoritative commit
boundaries.semantic_owner: Source owner for original fact; Auditctl for observation admission
boundaries.transport: argv subprocess; no shell or Python client API
boundaries.request: typed refs, bounded summary/detail, JSON metadata, publisher actor/source
boundaries.result: Generated stable ad:event ID and producer origin tuple on success
boundaries.errors: 10s timeout/nonzero/missing binary warn in Sprintctl; source operation remains committed
boundaries.identity_scope: Publisher/process actor is distinct from domain actor metadata; refs are not grants
boundaries.persistence: Local SQLite index plus original NDJSON record
boundaries.failure_retry: No publisher blind retry; each add mints a new ID, so reconcile fact refs/metadata before retry
boundaries.evidence: tests/test_publisher_contract.py; Sprintctl committed source edge; Agentops hook source edge
boundaries.gaps: Declared ActionQ/session/review mappings are contracts, not evidence each current publisher is deployed or invoked

boundaries.transport: CLI argv; SQLite transaction + filesystem locked append/fsync
boundaries.request: Validated event fields, optional resolved provenance/envelope metadata
boundaries.result: Text or JSON event generated by local owner
boundaries.errors: Validation/append/commit errors visible; missing artifacts root refuses writes
boundaries.identity_scope: Stable generated event ID, ledger origin_stream_id and monotonic origin_seq; local repo/artifact-root selection is not remote authorization
boundaries.persistence: NDJSON portable original/recovery source; SQLite derived index and local producer metadata
boundaries.failure_retry: Success establishes both copies; crash/commit failure can leave NDJSON ahead; next allocation reconciles shard prefix first; never one cross-store atomic transaction
boundaries.gaps: Filesystem/locking assumptions and old evidence bounds remain; no distributed or universal power-loss guarantee

boundaries.result: Current local indexed events or rendered view
boundaries.errors: Invalid filters/input fail through CLI; absence is not proof estate evidence is complete
boundaries.identity_scope: Local file access; no service tenant authorizer
boundaries.persistence: Reads derived SQLite index; no central connection
boundaries.failure_retry: Read does not import missing shards; rebuild is separate
boundaries.gaps: Row limit alone is not a generated transport-wide byte budget; no cross-language generated-view qualification

boundaries.producer: Explicit CLI caller with frozen overlay/source files
boundaries.semantic_owner: Agentops source/overlay verification; Auditctl bounded consumer and display
boundaries.transport: argv subprocess query-audit-attribution; private disk spool; finite timeout/response budget
boundaries.request: Explicit regular source and overlay files, optional attribution/filter/page controls
boundaries.result: auditctl-list-attribution/v1 wraps unchanged original_event with derived attribution/verification receipt
boundaries.errors: Malformed/oversized/unavailable helper result refuses entire report, never partial output
boundaries.identity_scope: Attribution does not change producer identity, authority, Decision or effective work status
boundaries.persistence: Read-only named snapshots; no index rebuild/update
boundaries.failure_retry: No discovery/automatic tails; caller retains exact frozen original bytes, not reserialized display objects
boundaries.gaps: Ordinary DB-backed attribution and actual S4 import remain Agentops#2592; helper pin is source qualification, not deployed-version proof

boundaries.request: Shard directory and explicit replace/dry-run/index-only policy
boundaries.result: Import/count report, idempotent canonical duplicate handling
boundaries.errors: Complete-input preflight rejects malformed/unsupported/gapped/conflicting records before mutation or replacement
boundaries.identity_scope: Event ID plus persisted canonical content/provenance; legacy envelope absence preserved
boundaries.persistence: Original shards unchanged; destination index reconstructs originals; replace backs up only after preflight
boundaries.failure_retry: Exact canonical duplicates skipped; conflicting same IDs reject whole batch; repeated rebuild converges
boundaries.gaps: Legacy/known-schema support is not a versioned cross-language decoder registry or whole-estate restore proof

boundaries.producer: Reviewer supplying manifest plus separately recorded exact SHA256
boundaries.semantic_owner: Auditctl source validation; Agentops Git/protected-tail verification; Sprintctl destination/S4 admission
boundaries.transport: Explicit no-follow regular files -> bounded JSON report
boundaries.result: Raw-line offsets/digests, source origin coverage, original/derived digest domains, source-only qualification
boundaries.errors: Duplicate JSON keys, changed files, tuple/id conflicts, gaps or declared-domain digest mismatch refuse; no partial import
boundaries.identity_scope: Manifest scope is asserted, not Git authenticity; unknown original digest domains remain unknown
boundaries.persistence: Read only; max4MiB manifest/512MiB source/100000 declared aggregate lines
boundaries.failure_retry: No DB/central access, source rewriting, import, authority or cutover; splitting streams does not prove full coverage
boundaries.gaps: Actual S4 inventory/provenance/rehearsal/causal gates and canonical foundation remain separate

boundaries.producer: Explicit composed-service caller or local owner-core caller
boundaries.transport: Existing protocol-v1 schemas over composed service; explicit connection factory
boundaries.request: Complete supported observation/decision envelope; submit transport key; bounded read selectors
boundaries.result: Stable receipt, observations/offset watermark, contiguous stream status, read-only compatibility
boundaries.errors: Hash/ID/tuple conflict, sequence gap, unsupported class/schema or incompatible runtime role fails closed
boundaries.identity_scope: Required submit/read authorities declared in catalog; actual entitlements/revocation are service qualification, not established by declaration
boundaries.persistence: Explicit central PostgreSQL observation+receipt+cursor transaction, separate from local stores
boundaries.failure_retry: Same origin tuple and canonical record hash yields original receipt after unknown response; receipt/dedup is not work/effect acceptance
boundaries.evidence: tests/test_central_contract.py; tests/test_vuoro_adapter.py; retained disposable-PG result packets
boundaries.gaps: No fresh PostgreSQL, live HTTP, unauthorized tenant/revocation/deletion, cross-machine restore or deployment campaign in this inventory

boundaries.semantic_owner: Auditctl migration assets; deployment owner for execution/credentials
boundaries.request: Versioned immutable SQL assets and configured schema/runtime/migration roles
boundaries.errors: Checksum drift, newer schema, same migration/runtime role or failed privilege setup refuses
boundaries.identity_scope: Runtime principal only bounded DML/reads; migration owner distinct; no CLI startup automatic migration
boundaries.persistence: Central schema ledger/assets; no local observation dependency
boundaries.failure_retry: Migration advisory lock/checksum/idempotence; source metadata is not current deployment evidence
boundaries.gaps: Backup schemas/keys, restore, whole-consumer cutover/rollback and actual DDL denial need release/runtime evidence from deployment owner

qualification: Inventory only; EC07 remains pending; no migration, release, deployed or acceptance claim
